Random Forest ensemble.

Fits a bagged ensemble of decision trees and appends a prediction column.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `RandomForestClassifier` |
| Search words | random, forest, ensemble, classification, classic ml |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table with features and target column |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Predictions** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus prediction column |
| **Model** | Parameters | No | 1 | Fitted tree model; link it to a Plot to draw the trees |
